notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Child and Adolescent Development and the Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Early Childhood Education are compatible with the B.A. in Child and Adolescent Development - Social and Community Contexts concentration at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. For Child and Adolescent Development advising, please contact the department at (916) 278-6639. For additional information, please visit: Child and Adolescent Development .
